name: tableau-desktop
description: Build and edit the workbook open in Tableau Desktop on this computer, through the local Tableau Desktop MCP server. Works in Claude Code, including the Claude Desktop app's Code tab. Needs Node.js 22.7.5 or later.

data_app_dir.title: Data app folder
data_app_dir.description: Absolute path of the folder where scaffold-data-app writes Tableau Desktop data apps. Leave empty if you don't build data apps.
